title: Add model runtime module

context.summary: Replace the narrow LLM adapter with a model runtime boundary that can own embeddings, OCR, ASR, vision and face capabilities.
context.background: TASK-36 centralized text embeddings behind @mindory/llm. The multimodal derived pipeline needs one broader runtime module with per-capability provider config, disabled capabilities and adapter contracts for both local and cloud model solutions.

in: Add @mindory/model-runtime as the shared runtime construction point for model-backed capabilities.
Move current text embedding construction from @mindory/llm to @mindory/model-runtime.
Represent text embedding, image embedding, image captioning, OCR, ASR, face detection and face recognition capability descriptors.
Replace active MINDORY_LLM_* configuration with MINDORY_MODEL_RUNTIME_* configuration.
Expose disabled, OpenAI-compatible, Ollama and local provider choices at the model runtime boundary.
Document local/free default model names for CLIP, OCR and face capabilities.
out: Implement OCR, ASR, image, video or face processors.
Add local model server images or heavy model downloads.
Maintain compatibility with old MINDORY_LLM_* environment variables.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/model-runtime is a workspace package and is referenced by API and worker runtime code.
API and worker no longer import or depend on @mindory/llm.
Current text embedding behavior still works through @mindory/model-runtime.
Config exposes per-capability model runtime settings and validates enabled capabilities.
Old MINDORY_LLM_* env names are removed from active runtime configuration.
Docs and validation scripts describe the model runtime boundary.

manual_checks: Confirm no active API or worker import points at @mindory/llm.
Confirm .env.example contains model runtime capability switches and local defaults.

risks: Renaming runtime config affects integration tests, Compose defaults and documentation together.
Local model names are descriptors only until future tasks wire local processor runtimes.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
